name: SikaTard®-960 HC
summary: SikaTard®-960 HC is an admixture designed to delay cement hydration. SikaTard®-960 HC facilitates stabilization of concrete mixtures for long periods with no negative effects on final quality.
metaDescription: SikaTard®-960 HC is an admixture designed to delay cement hydration. SikaTard®-960 HC facilitates stabilization of concrete mixtures for long periods with no negative effects on final quality.
attributes: Does not contain materials promoting steel corrosion.
Complements most of the ViscoCrete superplasticizer for a cost-effective shotcrete base mix.
With the use of Sigunit® accelerators cement hydration can be re-started on demand.
usage: SikaTard®-960 HC is recommended for the following applications:
where the temporary prevention of cement hydration of concrete is required
advantages: Does not contain materials promoting steel corrosion.

With the use of Sigunit® accelerators cement hydration can be re-started on demand.
packaging: Bulk deliveries 1000 litre IBC 10 litre container

items.label: CERTIFICATES AND TEST REPORTS
items.text: SikaTard®-960 HC is a set retarding admixture meeting the requirements of AS1478.1 – 2000 Type Re.

items.label: Composition
items.text: A solution of specially selected surface active organic compounds.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Stored at temperatures between 5° C and 35° C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight and frost, shelf life is one (1) year.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store protected from direct sunlight and frost at temperatures between 5° C and 35° C .
